text_block_list.text:
On our way back to the academy. Gold Ship 
dragged me onto a bus, saying there was 
somewhere she wanted to stop by.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Phew... The scent of the seats and that 
fluffy feel. Even the gentle rocking is 
just irresistible~

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Destination? Right here, obviously?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Like I said, on the bus.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Bass fishing has everything this 
world has to offer!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Look! That utility pole has been 
completely overrun by ivy! Hang in there, 
pole! Don't you dare lose, pole!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's with that dog staring at me? Is it 
sending Morse code by twitching its nose 
or somethin'~?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
T-I-R-E-D O-F T-H-I-S F-E-E-D... you say?! 
Hey, this is a huge deal, oi!!

With the scenery constantly changing 
outside the bus, even the easily bored 
Gold Ship didn't seem to grow tired of it—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm bored! Let's get off!

—It seemed that wasn't quite the case, 
however.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Trot-trot-trotting with a technical walk, 
let's head home looking the most gorgeous 
in the world, Trainer!

It's quite a long distance from here to 
Tracen Academy, though—
choice_data_list:
Try to convince them to take connecting 
buses home

text_block_list.text:
Together with Gold Ship, I decided to get 
off at the next bus stop.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's see where we are.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm? I'd estimate Tracen Academy is 
roughly around 10km from here."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Which means if I ride a deer, it'll take 
about 15 minutes to get there.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Welp, I'm gonna go look for some deer for 
a bit. See ya.

I gave it my all to stop Gold Ship as she 
started climbing the mountain—and somehow, 
we managed to return safely to the 
academy.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, if I stay still any longer, I'm gonna 
turn into a giant clam...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I don't even know where the hell 
we are, so pullin' off an advanced trick 
like transferrin' trains—

With that, she casually glanced out the 
window and froze, as if she had noticed 
something.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—No, wait. This route... This bus is 
definitely heading toward Tracen Academy.

The view outside is an unfamiliar country 
path. The destination display doesn't 
mention the Academy anywhere, either.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm serious. The other day, I memorized 
the entire route map just to kill time.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait a sec, that crow looks so cool! 
Alright, I'm gonna become a bird too!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So until we reach the academy, I'm gonna 
be a shoebill! Don't get in my way!

Whether she had really memorized it all or 
not—now that she had turned into a 
shoebill, there was no way to find out...

30 minutes later, just as Gold Ship said, 
the bus safely pulled up near Tracen 
Academy.
choice_data_list: She really did memorize the whole thing...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Grar! Bow-wow! Awooooo!

At any rate, we managed to make it back to 
the academy safely.
